q.personal.full_name.help: As it appears on your ID. This is the one question that can't be skipped.
q.personal.relation_line.help: Indian wills identify the testator through a parent or spouse.
q.personal.age_warning: You must be 18 or older to make a valid will in India. You can continue exploring the questions, but the will can't be generated.
q.personal.id_type: An ID to identify you by?
q.personal.id_type.help: Optional, but makes the will harder to dispute.
q.personal.id_value.help: For Aadhaar, enter only the last 4 digits.
q.personal.religion.help: Asked because inheritance law in India differs by religion. You can skip this.
q.personal.muslim_notice: Under Muslim personal law, bequests beyond one-third of your estate need your heirs' consent, and the rest devolves by inheritance shares. Your will can still record all your wishes — a compliance clause will be added so it works within these rules.
q.personal.children.help: Add each child. This also tells us whether guardianship questions apply.
q.personal.children.f.name: Name
q.personal.prior_will: Have you made a will before?
q.personal.prior_will_action.opt.revoke: Cancel it — this will replaces it
q.personal.prior_will_action.opt.update: I meant to only update it
q.personal.codicil_note: This tool always produces a complete fresh will that supersedes earlier ones — that's safer than amending an old will with a codicil.
q.personal.sound_mind: Confirm: you are making this will voluntarily, of your own free will, and you are of sound mind.
q.personal.sound_mind.help: Required by law — the will can't be generated without this.
q.personal.occupation.help: Optional — used only in the identity line of the will.
q.funeral.method: What should be done with your body?
q.funeral.method.opt.donate_science: Donate my body to medical science
q.funeral.burial.place.opt.public: A public burial ground near my home
q.funeral.burial.place.opt.practical: Wherever is practical for my family
q.funeral.burial.place_detail.help: Name and location — e.g. the mosque, church, or ground. Optional.
q.funeral.burial.rites.opt.customs: According to the customs of my faith
q.funeral.burial.rites.opt.simple: Keep it simple — no elaborate ceremony
q.funeral.cremation.place: Where should the cremation take place?
q.funeral.cremation.place.opt.practical: Wherever is practical for my family
q.funeral.cremation.place_detail.help: E.g. a particular ghat or riverside. Optional.
q.funeral.cremation.rites.opt.customs: According to the customs of my faith
q.funeral.cremation.rites.opt.simple: Keep it simple — no elaborate ceremony
q.funeral.body_donation.institution: Do you have an institution in mind?
No — my executor should arrange it
q.funeral.body_donation.fallback: If the donation can't be accepted, then:
q.funeral.body_donation.fallback.help: Institutions sometimes decline. Body donation also needs prior registration and family cooperation — tell your family now; the will alone acts too late.
q.funeral.memorial.opt.customs: According to the customs of my faith
q.funeral.notes: Anything else about your final rites?
q.funeral.notes.help: Optional — anything your family should know.
q.sf.contingent.mode: If they don't survive you, this should go to:
q.sf.contingent.group_mode: If any of them passes away before you, their share should:
q.sf.beneficiary.opt.sell: Sell it, and add the money to my estate
q.sf.beneficiary.opt.residuary: Let it pass with the rest of my estate
q.sf.contingent.group.opt.residuary: Go back to the rest of my estate
q.bank.mode: How do you want to deal with them?
q.bank.mode.opt.all: All accounts together, to the same people
q.bank.all.beneficiary: Who should receive the money in all your bank accounts?
q.bank.account.last4.help: Optional — never the full account number.
q.bank.account.beneficiary: Who should receive the money in this account?
q.bank.account.nomination: Does this account have a nominee?
q.bank.account.nomination.help: The will prevails over a nominee, but a mismatch causes hassle for your family.
q.bank.account.nomination.opt.same: Yes — the same person as above
q.bank.locker.gate: Do you have a bank locker?
q.bank.locker.contents.help: Optional — a short description helps your executor.
q.bank.locker.beneficiary: Who should receive the contents of your locker?
q.bank.cash.gate: Do you keep cash at home or elsewhere?
q.realestate.gate: Do you own any land or buildings?
q.realestate.item.desc.help: Enough detail that a stranger could identify it — address, survey number, extent.
q.realestate.item.ownership.ancestral_no: You can only will away your own share of ancestral property. This will be worded as your share, right, title and interest.
q.realestate.item.action.opt.life_intere: Let someone live there for life, then pass it on
q.realestate.item.action.opt.sell: Sell it and distribute the money
q.realestate.item.action.opt.residuary: Let it pass with the rest of my estate
q.realestate.item.life.occupant: Who should be able to live there for their lifetime?
q.realestate.item.life.remainder: And after them, who should it pass to?
q.realestate.item.rented: Is it rented out or occupied by someone?
q.realestate.item.rented.instructions.op: Continue the tenancy, rent to the new owner
q.realestate.item.loan: Is there a loan against it?
q.realestate.item.loan.help: This links to what you told us under Debts, if you covered that section.
q.residuary.primary.help: This is the safety net of your will — anything not specifically given away, or any gift that fails, passes under this clause.
q.residuary.primary.charity.help: Name and place — identify it precisely.
q.residuary.contingent: If none of them survive you, everything else goes to:
q.residuary.contingent.opt.legal_heirs: My legal heirs, as the law provides
q.executors.physical.primary.help: Your executor carries out this will — collects assets, pays debts, distributes property. Choose someone you trust.
q.executors.physical.secondary: If they can't act, who steps in?
q.executors.digital.same: And your digital life — same executor?
q.executors.digital.primary.help: Pick whoever is actually good with technology.
q.executors.powers.help: Sell assets to pay debts, sign documents, hire a lawyer/accountant, settle claims.
q.executors.compensation.opt.none: No payment — but all expenses reimbursed
q.executors.informed: Does your executor know they're named?
